author: Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: studied from 1929 at Vienna classical, IE and Iranian philology and Indology.

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: From 1932 worked as Librarian at Indogermanisches Institut.

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: started teaching at Elisabeth-Gymnasium, but in 1938 lost both positions.

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: After the war taught at Bundesgymnasium Wien IX, where he also gave a voluntary course of Sanskrit.

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: taught classical philology as PD from 1960.

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: From 1960 also Lehrbefugnis as Lektor (Lecturer) for Sanskrit.

relations.subject: KRAUSE, Wilhelm
relations.evidence: From 1968 title of eo. Professor at Graz and in May 1976 nominated ord., but died a few days after.
